name: Solar Optimum Glendale
old_description: Since 2008, Solar Optimum has helped thousands of homeowners and businesses gain energy freedom with our award-winning solar and battery storage solutions.
about:
Solar Optimum is headquartered in Glendale, California, and has been operating since 2008. The privately held company was founded with a mission to educate, inspire, and provide homeowners and businesses with premium energy and roofing solutions.

The firm specializes in residential and commercial solar panel installation, battery storage systems, roofing, and energy maintenance services. As an elite platinum-certified installer, it works exclusively with American-made equipment from brands such as QCells, Enphase, Unirac, Tesla, GAF, and CertainTeed. Solar Optimum has completed thousands of installations across California and has been ranked the #1 solar and battery storage installer in the U.S. by Solar Power World for six consecutive years.

Its customer base includes homeowners seeking energy independence and businesses aiming to stabilize utility costs and meet sustainability goals. The company serves the residential solar, commercial solar, battery storage, and roofing sectors, with a focus on the California market.

Solar Optimum differentiates itself through its 25-year performance guarantee and end-to-end warranty coverage, its commitment to American-made products, and a track record that includes five National Solar Installer of the Year awards. The company emphasizes transparent consulting, real relationships, and honest talk as core to its approach.
